thread:
Holly Nguyen: Lighthouse Labs onboarding - blocking items for Thu daytime cutover: (1) exact audit log envelope they expect, (2) confirmation that CMK will be customer-owned and rotation policy. Can we close both today?

Ethan Roy: They mentioned JSONL lines with tenant + trace_id. Ask them to paste a sample if they already have one.

Vera Morales: Pasting sample they sent (single-line JSON per event):
```json
{"tenant":"lighthouse","trace_id":"tr-77a","ts":"2026-03-22T10:15:00Z","event":"response","model":"rwd-13b","resp_tokens":64,"latency_ms":85,"pii_redacted":true}
```

Ethan Roy: Good. On KMS - do they require us to be key admin? If not, we need a policy that only grants crypto ops and denies admin actions.

Holly Nguyen: They require customer-managed CMK in their account. Rotation: management by their security team, rotation every 120 days. They want aliasing so application config can point to alias:/rlw/lighthouse and not change on rekey.

sec-bot: Security checklist reminder: - Audit events must include tenant + trace_id + ts. - Mask any PII before emission. - KMS key policy must limit Admin actions to Lighthouse security principals and grant our service principal only Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. - Deny ScheduleKeyDeletion and DisableKey for our principal.

Ethan Roy: Networking: Lighthouse has strict egress allowlist. They will only accept log traffic from three IPs. Which public IPs will our appliance present? If they NAT on their side, we only need hostname/cert.

Vera Morales: They prefer customer NAT with Elastic IPs. But asked for our fallback egress IPs in case they need them for a short test window. I'll document both options in the runbook.

log-bot: runbook updated by Vera Morales - added steps: "audit-jsonl-sample", "customer-cmk-120d", "egress-ip-options". Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Lighthouse/runbook (internal)

Ethan Roy: I'll draft the KMS policy snippet and post after the 20-min call. Quick proposed snippet for Lighthouse to paste into their key policy (they will edit principals/ARNs):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/lh-security-admin"},"Action":"kms:*","Resource":"*"},{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role:redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444555666777:key/abcd1234","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceVpce":"vpce-0aa1bb2c"}}},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role:redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","kms:DisableKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444555666777:key/abcd1234"}]}
```

Holly Nguyen: Scheduling a 15-min sync at 11:30 PT to confirm key policy and egress approach. Invite sent to Lighthouse security and our infra.

Vera Morales: After the call I'll update the runbook diff and add the cert fingerprint exchange step for mTLS to the log forwarder flow.

Ethan Roy: Will follow up with the exact runbook diff and the KMS snippet email to their security alias. :white_check_mark:

Holly Nguyen: Thanks team. I'll mark readiness once Lighthouse posts the CMK ARN and their chosen egress option (customer NAT or allowlist our IPs).
